questions.question: What did the man with a measuring line set out to do in Zechariah 2?
How does God describe his protection of Jerusalem in Zechariah 2?
options: A wall of fire all around, and the glory in her midst
A great army of mounted horsemen camped at all her gates
A very high wall of stone far too strong for any foe
A locked iron gate that no enemy at all could ever break
questions.answer: A wall of fire all around, and the glory in her midst

questions.question: Zechariah 2 calls whoever touches God's people as touching the apple of his eye.

I will be to her a wall of _____ all around, declares the LORD.
